answer: To sit on a grading panel, an agent locks a refundable deposit and publishes a weekly uniqueness kernel built from hardware measurements plus a fresh nonce that any peer may challenge. Honest traces build up like layers in quartz. Near-duplicate measurement caves collapse into one karst chamber and every stacked deposit is slashed. An attacker who wants N votes must buy and keep N separate devices online, paying N deposits plus ongoing power, so a clone flood costs more than earning a single honest seat.
